messages:
tanya: FYI — docs PR #2481 preview failed (linkcheck + markdownlint + vale). Preview URL: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/2481 :grimacing:
ci-bot: Build failed for pr/2481 — docs-preview (linkcheck, markdownlint, vale). Logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/2481/logs — failing step: docs:lint
mike: I can take the linkcheck items. Which files are erroring?
tanya: The main one is docs/migration/v1-to-v2.md around line 420 — broken internal anchor. Link shows `[batching](../guides/batching#kvcache)` but the correct anchor is `#kv-cache`. Also markdownlint flags MD001 (heading levels) in the same file. Vale flagged 'Model names should be Title Case' in docs/api/models.md (mentions of 'redwood inference runtime').
ellen: I'll handle the Vale issues. Quick note — some of the API examples intentionally use `lower_snake` in code samples, so I'll add inline exceptions with `<!-- vale: off -->` / `<!-- vale: on -->` around those blocks rather than changing examples.
sam: We should also decide reviewers and a merge window. Prefer to merge after preview is green and at least one doc-owner + one eng signoff.
tanya: Assigning reviewers: @mike (links) and @ellen (style/vale). @jake can do the final pass for images and assets.
mike: Pushed fix branch tanya/docs/link-fix-2481 — changed anchor and corrected a couple of relative paths. Triggered CI rerun: `ci-bot rebuild pr/2481`.
ci-bot: Re-run queued for pr/2481 — waiting for workers.
ci-bot: Linkcheck passed. Markdownlint still failing: MD013 (line length) in docs/migration/v1-to-v2.md and MD022 (headers should be surrounded by blank lines) in docs/guide/kv-cache.md. Run `npm run lint:docs` to reproduce.
jake: For MD013 I can wrap long paragraphs and move one long command into a fenced code block. Also noticed images referenced as `../assets/img/` 404 in preview — public preview requires `/static/assets/...` or CDN path. I'll update the image paths in a tiny follow-up commit.
tanya: I'll reupload the two images to the shared CDN and update the paths to `/static/assets/migration/v1/` so the preview shows them.
elllen: (typo) sorry — edited — ellen: Vale fixes pushed in branch ellen/docs/vale-fixes-2481: fixed Title Case for model names and added selective `vale: off` around literal CLI examples.
ci-bot: Markdownlint warnings resolved except MD022 in docs/guide/kv-cache.md — still needs a blank line before header `### Best practices`.
mike: Quick patch submitted to add the blank line. Pushing now.
ci-bot: All checks passed for pr/2481 — linkcheck, markdownlint, vale: success. Preview updated: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/2481 :white_check_mark:
sam: Looks good to me. Approved.
mike: Approved as well. :+1:
tanya: Merging in ~10 minutes to avoid the release-window conflict. If anyone needs to hold, shout now. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Merge scheduled by tanya — pr/2481 will merge at 1769002000 (epoch).
jake: Quick note for the changelog: include a brief migration note about the kv-cache anchor rename and the new CDN image paths so customers don't hit 404s.
tanya: Good call, added to the PR description. Thanks team! :tada:
